name: mirage
text: That paste only carries the ranked findings (and was cut at 20,000 characters), so the logged events aren't in it. Please send the full diagnostics file instead, as an attachment or the whole report text. The part I need is further down. For the disappearing bets, it lists each time a bet left the list and which check hid it. For 'no one was selling', version 1.0.74 adds a log of every such bet, covering how old its price was, the price, and how deep the book was. 1.0.74 is building now and I'll message you when it's out. Install it, bet or let the list run for a while, then send the full file.
